input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (CISG disapplied) and 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and a mutual carve-out for temporary injunctive relief to protect confidential information or IP. That matches the preferred position exactly: accepted governing law plus courts rather than arbitration; no arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document. The pre-suit executive escalation in 28.3 is mutual, capped at fifteen business days, and expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-preserving filings, so it does not impair access to the agreed forum. No redline needed.
